mapper.select: SELECT payment_id , payment_type , amount , status , method , paid_at , created_at , fair_id , business_id , payer_user_id , reservation_id , application_id FROM payment WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = 'COMPLETED', method = #{method}, toss_payment_key = #{tossPaymentKey}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'PENDING'
